data.title: 白金 · 丝绒被褥间的心跳距离
data.description: 【私密寝居·夜色正浓】月光如水穿过半掩的窗扉，与床头暖灯交汇。白金轻倚在靠枕上，纯白蕾丝与如雪银发交融，青蓝眼眸中泛着温润的水光。她微微倾身，呼吸温热可触，等待着仅属于两人的漫长夜晚。
data.action: 半倚软枕微启双唇近身倾诉
data.lighting: 清冷窗月与床畔温润壁灯冷暖交融
data.promptProse: In a quiet midnight bedroom, Platinum reclines against soft pillows and leans forward toward the viewer with a gentle blush and parted lips. Dressed in a pure white floral lace lingerie set with delicate ribbon bows and sheer lace thigh-high stockings, she glows where silver window moonlight meets the warm bedside wall lamp.
data.animaCaption: Reclining against plush pillows in white floral lace lingerie and sheer thigh-high stockings, she leans close toward the viewer with flushed cheeks and softly parted lips. Cool window moonlight blends with warm bedside lamplight across the sheets.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pure white floral lace lingerie set with a sheer mesh bralette, delicate ribbon bows, and matching white lace thigh-high stockings.
